# M1-03 — Scope Baseline (In / Out / Deferred)

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-high`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] List explicit in-scope capabilities for the M1 baseline
- [ ] List explicit out-of-scope items
- [ ] List deferred/future-scope items and why they are deferred
- [ ] Select at least one deliberate exclusion/deferment and write its justification
- [ ] Cross-check scope statement against the Minimum Business Capabilities in the Master Project Brief
- [ ] Integrate scope statement into PED v1.0 and mark as baselined

## Acceptance Criteria
- Scope is expressed as three explicit lists (in / out / deferred), not prose only.
- At least one exclusion/deferment has a written, defensible rationale (evidence-based, not "we ran out of time").
- Scope statement does not silently drop any of the brief's minimum business capabilities without justification.
- Team can defend how uncontrolled scope creep will be prevented after baseline.
